title: Why Small Habits Beat Big Goals

scenes.narration: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
A goal is a destination. A system is the road you actually walk every day.
One percent better each day compounds into thirty-seven times better in a year.
So stop negotiating with motivation. Make the first step absurdly small.
Small habits beat big goals. Every single time.
